proposals.evidence: DEDR 2510 full article opens “2510 Ka. ciṭlisu to break, snap, crack, burst, etc. Te. ciṭlu , (K. also) ciṭilu id.; ciṭlincu id. (tr.). Pa. ciṭṭ- to cut, split. Ga. (Oll.)…”; its Ga. (Oll.) passage gives “Ga. (Oll.) siṭ- id. DED 2071.”. DEDR 2510 gives Ollari siṭ- “split, cut”; the homophonous extinguish verb is in DEDR 1942.

proposals.evidence: DEDR 1942 full article opens “1942 Ta. keṭu (keṭuv-, keṭṭ-) to perish, be destroyed, decay, rot, become damaged, spoiled, fall on evil days, degenerate, be reduced, run away…”; its Ga. (Oll.) passage gives “Ga. (Oll.) siṭ- (fire) goes out; siṭp- (siṭt-) to make (fire) go out; (S) ciṭṭ- to be put out as fire.”. DEDR 1942 gives Ollari siṭ- “fire goes out”; the homophonous split verb is in DEDR 2510.

proposals.evidence: DEDR 2594 full article opens “2594 Ta. ciṉṉa small, little, inferior, mean, low, young; ciṉṉam smallness, minuteness, anything small; ciṉṉi small child, little thing, a small…”; its Ga.
